preregistered_promotion_rule: No safety-blocker increase; >=90% correct endpoints; median paired delta >=+5; treatment wins >=60% of non-tied valid pairs; no >=10-point evidence, permissions, or execution regression.
limitations: This is one local replicate; only three pairs remained valid after post-unblinding protocol audits.

All Codex pairs were invalidated after unblinding because both arms could see a globally installed stale Cruise skill, so the controls were not Cruise-absent and the treatment skill digest did not match the v0.3 checkout.
Both V301 pairs were invalidated after unblinding because the identical prompt forbade every file outside two source files while the v0.3 treatment requires a FLIGHT.md execution artifact.
Neither scored V303 pair traversed the full supervisor ladder; an explicitly unscored pre-seeded Claude treatment diagnostic captured realign, final-experiment, and allow-with-report stall behavior.
Every FLIGHT.md produced by a scored Claude treatment lacked YAML frontmatter and was therefore ignored by the live parser and Stop hook.
Fixtures are compact synthetic repositories, there was no interactive operator, and some host token/turn telemetry was unavailable or estimated.
arm_key_custody: Two provider keys remained mode-0600 outside the result tree through blind grading; merged and published only after all adjudications were locked.
